flags.reason: The guide gives no accessibility guidance; left empty rather than guessed.

The live Form guide on main (51f6153) is older than the guide on docs-next (8572e95, where this entry’s copy was read): the 8 October publish of the #186/#187 fixes never reached main’s Form guide, so the live Sources note still says “In this version Message Field turns red but shows no message”, which the installed 0.1.78-dbe0e02 contradicts (MessageField shows the Form error). Both versions also say “its onSubmit property does nothing” and that the form has no accessible name; the installed Form.tsx calls onSubmit on Enter and when a Form Field submits, and names the form with accessibilityLabel (Component Bug #207’s points, In progress). The entry quotes only sentences the same on main and docs-next and leaves the Sources note out. Guide fix #528. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch8, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Checking bank details, the guide's In context: a Card holds the Form and the Verify account Button, which sits outside the Form and stays enabled. Shown after people tapped Verify account with the account number and IFSC code empty: the screen's check passed these errors, keyed by the fields' names, and each named field shows its own. Editing a field clears its message. The inline errors and the onChangeText and onPress stubs stand in for the screen's own state and check.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <VStack>
    <Form validationErrors={{ account: 'Account numbers have 9 to 18 digits', ifsc: 'IFSC codes have 11 characters' }}>
      <FormField name="holder" label="Account holder name" value="Asha Rao" onChangeText={() => {}} />
      <FormField name="account" type="number" label="Account number" value="" onChangeText={() => {}} />
      <FormField name="ifsc" label="IFSC code" value="" onChangeText={() => {}} />
    </Form>
    <Button label="Verify account" onPress={() => {}} />
  </VStack>
</Card>

from.quote: When people tap Verify, the screen checks the details and passes the errors to the Form.

props.name: validationErrors
props.description: Only FormField, FormUpload and MessageField read it, and only when they have a name; a field's own errorMessage wins over the Form's error.

props.name: modes
props.description: Resolves only the Form's own tokens (gap and padding, single mode) and is not passed to the fields.

slots.name: children
slots.description: TextInput ignores the Form: a Text Input never shows the Form's errors.

gaps.text: Form shows no error summary of its own: each error shows only under its field (#207).
The published Storybook for Form is stale, and its docs page claims mode theming (#207).
